{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Otheruses|lightspeed}}
[[File:Hyperspace_falcon.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]]]
{{Quote|Now hang onto your fur&hellip; we're going to pop into light speed.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
'''Lightspeed''',<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> also known as '''ultralight''' or '''ultralightspeed''',<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> was slang for the speed at which a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveled through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. In reality, though, a class 1.0 [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] could propel a ship through hyperspace faster than light, allowing a ship to cross [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in a matter of [[Standard day|days]]. Hyperspace could be dangerous without the right [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|coordinates]].<ref name="KOTOR">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11" />
